question.text: Value cash transactions in the Indian forex market may be undertaken only up to what time?

answer.text: 5:00 PM IST, except for individual persons
No time restriction for cash transactions

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 24, value cash transactions may be undertaken only up to 5.00 pm IST, except for individual persons. Individual-person value cash transactions may occur on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays as per bank policy. The Trap: The 5.00 pm cut-off applies specifically to value cash transactions, not to all forex business. Note: Page 24 also confirms that NOOP limits must be maintained at all times, including for transactions executed beyond market hours.
